chunks.label: Prices and shop counters
chunks.rationale: Lets you say prices and buy or order things by the piece, bottle, sheet or cup.
chunks.interference: -hon and -hai share the same changes (ippon/ippai, sanbon/sanbai); 4 yen is yoen.

chunks.label: How many times
chunks.rationale: Lets you say how often something happened and ask how many times.
chunks.interference: -kai and -do mean the same here; ikkai is also 'ground floor'.

chunks.label: Animals, machines, books
chunks.rationale: Lets you count pets, cars and devices, and books.
chunks.interference: -hiki changes like -hon (ippiki, sanbiki, roppiki); -dai never changes.

chunks.label: Turns, floors and rooms
chunks.rationale: Lets you name a turn, a floor, a place in line, a room or an address block.
chunks.interference: Floor -kai sounds like 'times' -kai; sangai is 3rd floor but sankai is three times.

chunks.label: Units of measure
chunks.rationale: Lets you give distances, heights, weights and volumes.
chunks.interference: Kiro can be kilograms or kilometres; ikkiro and issenchi shrink like native counters.

chunks.label: Set count expressions
chunks.rationale: Lets you say double, a few times, never once, and overnight.
chunks.interference: nibai (twice as much) vs nikai (twice); nandoka (a few times) vs nando mo (again and again).

chunks.label: Telling the hour
chunks.rationale: Lets you ask and tell the time to the half hour, morning or afternoon.
chunks.interference: yoji, shichiji and kuji break the number pattern; nanji (what time) vs nanjikan (how many hours).

chunks.label: Minutes and roughly when
chunks.rationale: Lets you give exact minutes, rough times, and how long ago.
chunks.interference: -mae means both 'to the hour' and 'ago'; goro is for times, gurai for amounts.

chunks.label: How long it takes
chunks.rationale: Lets you say how many hours, minutes, seconds or weeks something lasts.

chunks.label: Saying your age
chunks.rationale: Lets you give your age and ask someone else's.
chunks.interference: hassai and jussai shrink; twenty is hatachi, not nijuusai.

chunks.label: Counting years
chunks.rationale: Lets you give a year, say how many years, and name a school year.
chunks.interference: Four years is yonen, not yonnen; nannen can mean 'what year' or 'how many years'.

chunks.label: Comparing ages
chunks.rationale: Lets you talk about age, being the same age, or someone's decade.
chunks.interference: nijuudai (in one's twenties) vs hatachi (exactly twenty).

chunks.label: Years later and since
chunks.rationale: Lets you say a few years, years later, and the first time in years.

drops.reason: Tokenizer fragment of X-ji han (e.g. sanji han); covered by 半 (han) and 一時 (-ji).
